The code_review approval is from declan.farrell@fernbrook.example, a change_approver for baseline-mortgage and a different person from the author Wen Li (p-wli).

No acceptance-ledger entry covers AppLog.java or any other path this change touches, so no earlier evidence lapses.

summary: PR-1823 changes the in-memory log buffer size in AppLog.java, which belongs to the security-sensitive mortgage.logging component. CHG-5 therefore requires a security_review from someone with the security_reviewer role, but the security review was signed by Declan Farrell, an engineer and change approver who does not hold that role. The ticket, independent code review and CI on the final commit are in order, but the missing valid security review violates CHG-5, so the change is rejected. LOG-1 also lacks the exhaustive evidence it requires; the only evidence is a passing sample control test.
